events.title: Asunaro Festival

events.title: Nakano x Suginami x Toshima Anime and Manga Festival
events.summary: Anime and manga fans can enjoy special studio screening events, talk shows, and exhibitions celebrating subculture industries.

events.summary: A massive community festival featuring local exchange fairs, delicious food booths, stage performances, kids' activities, and vehicle displays.

events.summary: Discover local businesses, industrial history, and unique enterprises from across the neighborhood through interactive displays.

events.summary: Enjoy local performances, pounded rice, vegetable sales, and local recipe tastings.

events.title: Ogikubo Center Festival

events.summary: Buy local vegetables, flowers, and handmade goods from welfare facilities while joining farming activities.

events.title: Boy Scout Autumn Festival
events.summary: Enjoy outdoor games, food stalls, and a charity bazaar hosted by the local scouts.

events.title: Christmas Market for All Ages
events.summary: Enjoy mini concerts, Christmas workshops, games, and festive food and goods sales.

events.title: Comi-Fura Hon-Amanuma Noel Festival
